root_cause: Underlying runtime/OS pipe EOF cause unresolved; blocked synchronous stdin delivery isolated and avoided with regular-file stdin.
observation: Git hash-object --stdin waited in read/strbuf_read while its Node parent waited in SyncProcessRunner/uv__io_poll. No test assertion result was produced for either stalled run. Only command-identity-verified owned processes were signaled through their process-group supervisor.

runtime_selection: Final gate uses original Node v22.14.0 and pinned /usr/bin/git. A Node24-only workaround was disproven and is not used.

repair.change: Pass the exact source bytes to the same path-aware pinned Git hash command through a private regular-file descriptor instead of a pipe; close descriptor and remove temporary directory in finally. The temporary file is only hashing input, never the authoritative readiness artifact.
repair.deviation: Required verification-blocker repair under user automation-first instructions; deviates from Plan26 helper-freeze action while preserving artifact/source/route semantics.
